scope: Linux and macOS passwd initialization before getpwuid_r
replacement: Linux explicitly initializes five string pointers to null and uid/gid to zero. macOS uses the pinned libc 0.2.190 safe generated Default, including null pw_class and zero pw_change/pw_expire.
compatibility: Native lookup, buffer size/lifetime, identity lookup, empty-result handling and returned name bytes are unchanged. Other Unix targets retain their existing initialization; Windows is unchanged. No public API or dependency change.
inventory: One unsafe initialization operation removed on supported Unix targets. Existing lexical block remains only under other-Unix cfg. Compiler diagnostic reduction requires capture and reviewed baseline reconciliation after #117.
exclusion: This does not prove getpwuid_r/getuid unavoidable or approve other Unix initialization as a permanent exception.
